Jamb and Knob sealed it. Doorjamb and doorknob both force the same opening word, so Way Mat Bell Jamb Knob can be checked as one phrase pattern.
That full-board check turns Way into doorway and Mat into doormat instead of leaving them as loose standalone meanings.
The answer was "Words that come after “door”".
